title: The Cottages Where Form Surrenders to Light

features.name: the fading threshold
features.desc-on-touch: The gate holds its shape like a question mark drawn in amber light. Beyond it, the row continues — but the cottages have become suggestions, each one fainter than the last, until they are indistinguishable from the light itself.

features.name: window traces
features.desc-on-touch: A cottage window glows with a warmth that has no source. You can almost see the interior — a room, a table, a figure — before the light dissolves it. The window remembers what it held.

features.name: the last defined corner
features.desc-on-touch: Here, the corner of a cottage roof still casts a shadow — but the shadow is lighter than the air around it. It is the final proof that something stood here, before suggestion became the only inheritance.

features.name: the garden learning to be only fragrance
features.desc-on-touch: Nothing grows here anymore, or everything is growing into pure air. The soil itself has become pale, colour draining from it like water. A scent arrives before you see what might have made it.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the row where fading is its own belonging
narr: You stand at the edge of the cottages with her, both of you
watching the light drain from the windows. She says: look,
they are learning to be only what they meant, now that meaning
is all they have. You reach for her hand but your fingers pass
through something already more light than substance.
Her grip tightens. Later the cottage will fade. First comes this.

inscription: the cottages have learned that staying and fading are the same gesture, held long enough until the holding is no longer required
